score_rationale: Raw score is 10 (4+2+1+1+1+1), reduced by 1 for the presence of the STATVLD centralised validation service program. Final score: 9/10 HIGH RISK. Six of seven files reference CUST_STATUS directly. The field drives a 4-state state machine with 12 transition rules, is written in two independent locations (CUSTMAST.rpg and ORDPROC.rpgle), and appears in both interactive and batch processing paths. The auto-suspension rule (balance > 110% of credit limit) is duplicated with inconsistent implementation style between CUSTMAST (inline) and ORDPROC (via STATVLD). Any change to CUST_STATUS requires coordinated testing of all six dependent programs.
